text_en: But now hear, O Jacob my servant, Israel whom I have chosen!
text_cn: 但是现在，我的仆人雅各伯！我所拣选的以色列！你听吧！

text_en: Thus says the Lord who made you, who formed you in the womb and will help you: Do not fear, O Jacob my servant, Jeshurun whom I have chosen.
text_cn: 那造成你，从母胎形成你，且协助你的上主这样说：“我的仆人雅各伯！我所拣选的耶叔戎， 你不要害怕！

text_en: For I will pour water on the thirsty land, and streams on the dry ground; I will pour my spirit upon your descendants, and my blessing on your offspring.
text_cn: 因为我要把水倒在干地上，使豪雨落在旱陆上；我要把我的神倾注在你的苗裔身上，把我的祝福降在你的子孙身上。

text_en: They shall spring up like a green tamarisk, like willows by flowing streams.
text_cn: 他们要生长，有如水边的青草，又如溪畔的杨柳。

text_en: This one will say, “I am the Lord ’s, ” another will be called by the name of Jacob, yet another will write on the hand, “The Lord ’s, ” and adopt the name of Israel.
text_cn: 这个说：‘我是上主的’，那个要起雅各伯的名字，另一个要在手上写：‘属于上主’，并要起以色列的名号”。

text_en: Thus says the Lord , the King of Israel, and his Redeemer, the Lord of hosts: I am the first and I am the last; besides me there is no god.
text_cn: 上主，以色列的君王，救主，万军的上主这样说：“我是元始，我是终末，在我以外没有别的神。

text_en: Who is like me? Let them proclaim it, let them declare and set it forth before me. Who has announced from of old the things to come? Let them tell us what is yet to be.
text_cn: 谁相似我？让他前来伸述，让他说明，给我拿出证据来！谁能从永远预言未来的事，请他告诉我们快要发生的事吧！

text_en: Do not fear, or be afraid; have I not told you from of old and declared it? You are my witnesses! Is there any god besides me? There is no other rock; I know not one.
text_cn: 你们不必惊慌，不用害怕！我不是早已告诉过你，早已宣布了吗？你们是我的证人，在我以外还有别的神吗？决没有别的磐石！我一个也不认识！”

text_en: All who make idols are nothing, and the things they delight in do not profit; their witnesses neither see nor know. And so they will be put to shame.
text_cn: 制造偶像的人都是虚无，他们所喜爱的，也毫无用处；他们的见证人一无所见，毫无所知，必将蒙受耻辱。

text_en: Who would fashion a god or cast an image that can do no good?
text_cn: 有谁制造神像或铸偶像，不想得利呢？

text_en: Look, all its devotees shall be put to shame; the artisans too are merely human. Let them all assemble, let them stand up; they shall be terrified, they shall all be put to shame.
text_cn: 看哪！凡作他伙伴的，都要蒙受耻辱，因为制造偶像的，也只是人而已！让他们集合起来一同前来吧！他们必要惊慌羞愧！

text_en: The ironsmith fashions it and works it over the coals, shaping it with hammers, and forging it with his strong arm; he becomes hungry and his strength fails, he drinks no water and is faint.
text_cn: 铁匠先在炭火上工作，再用锤子打成偶像；他用大力的手臂工作，当饥饿时，也就没有力量；没有水喝，他就疲劳不堪。

text_en: The carpenter stretches a line, marks it out with a stylus, fashions it with planes, and marks it with a compass; he makes it in human form, with human beauty, to be set up in a shrine.
text_cn: 木匠伸展绳墨，用笔划线，后拿刨子刨平，再用圆规测量，做成一个人形，具有人的美丽，好供在庙里。

text_en: He cuts down cedars or chooses a holm tree or an oak and lets it grow strong among the trees of the forest. He plants a cedar and the rain nourishes it.
text_cn: 人先砍伐一块香柏，或取一块榆木，或橡木；或在树林中选一块坚固的木料，或自己种植一棵月桂树，让雨水使之长大。

text_en: Then it can be used as fuel. Part of it he takes and warms himself; he kindles a fire and bakes bread. Then he makes a god and worships it, makes it a carved image and bows down before it.
text_cn: 这些木料原是为人作燃料，原可用来取暖，也可燃烧烘烤面包；人却用它来作神像去恭敬，或做偶像去叩拜：

text_en: Half of it he burns in the fire; over this half he roasts meat, eats it and is satisfied. He also warms himself and says, “Ah, I am warm, I can feel the fire! ”
text_cn: 人把一半木头投入火中燃烧，在火炭上烤肉吃；待吃饱了烤肉，又取了暖，遂说：“哈哈！我暖和了，也觉得有了火！”

text_en: The rest of it he makes into a god, his idol, bows down to it and worships it; he prays to it and says, “Save me, for you are my god! ”
text_cn: 遂用剩下的一半作了一个神像，一个偶像，向它叩拜，俯伏恳求说：“求你救我，因为你是我的神！”

text_en: They do not know, nor do they comprehend; for their eyes are shut, so that they cannot see, and their minds as well, so that they cannot understand.
text_cn: 他们不了解，也不觉悟，因为他们的眼糊住了，什么也看不见；他们的心也不知觉悟，

text_en: No one considers, nor is there knowledge or discernment to say, “Half of it I burned in the fire; I also baked bread on its coals, I roasted meat and have eaten. Now shall I make the rest of it an abomination? Shall I fall down before a block of wood? ”
text_cn: 也不回心想一下，也不会明智通达地说：“一半木头我已投入火中烧了，并在火炭上烤了面包，烤了肉吃；我竟将剩下的一半作了一个怪物，向这块木头敬拜。”

text_en: He feeds on ashes; a deluded mind has led him astray, and he cannot save himself or say, “Is not this thing in my right hand a fraud? ”
text_cn: 他所追求的仅是一把灰；他迷惑的心领他走入歧途，而不能自拔，也不会问说：“我右手所拿的不是虚无吗？”

text_en: Remember these things, O Jacob, and Israel, for you are my servant; I formed you, you are my servant; O Israel, you will not be forgotten by me.
text_cn: 雅各伯啊！你要记住这些事！以色列啊！你也应记住，因为你是我的仆人，我造了你，是叫你作我的仆人。以色列啊！我决不会忘了你！

text_en: I have swept away your transgressions like a cloud, and your sins like mist; return to me, for I have redeemed you.
text_cn: 我消除了你的罪过，有如烟消；我消除了你的愆尤，有如云散；归依我吧！因为我救赎了你。

text_en: Sing, O heavens, for the Lord has done it; shout, O depths of the earth; break forth into singing, O mountains, O forest, and every tree in it! For the Lord has redeemed Jacob, and will be glorified in Israel.
text_cn: 诸天，欢腾吧！因为上主作了这一切；地下的深渊，欢呼吧！山岭、森林和其中的树木，高声歌唱吧！因为上主拯救了雅各伯，在以色列显扬了自己。

text_en: Thus says the Lord , your Redeemer, who formed you in the womb: I am the Lord , who made all things, who alone stretched out the heavens, who by myself spread out the earth;
text_cn: 你的救主，由母胎形成你的上主这样说：“我是创造万有的上主，只有我展开了诸天，布置了大地，谁与我同在？

text_en: who frustrates the omens of liars, and makes fools of diviners; who turns back the wise, and makes their knowledge foolish;
text_cn: 是我破坏了占卜者的预兆，使巫士成为愚妄，使智者退后，使他们的知识变为愚蠢；

text_en: who confirms the word of his servant, and fulfills the prediction of his messengers; who says of Jerusalem, “It shall be inhabited, ” and of the cities of Judah, “They shall be rebuilt, and I will raise up their ruins”;
text_cn: 是我叫我仆人们的话实现，叫我使者们的计谋成功；是我论及耶路撒冷说：‘你必要有人居住。’论及犹大各城说：‘你们要被重建，我必要重建你们的废址。’

text_en: who says to the deep, “Be dry— I will dry up your rivers”;
text_cn: 是我对深渊说：‘你必涸(hé)竭(jié)，我要使你的河流干涸。’

text_en: who says of Cyrus, “He is my shepherd, and he shall carry out all my purpose”; and who says of Jerusalem, “It shall be rebuilt, ” and of the temple, “Your foundation shall be laid. ”
text_cn: 是我论及居鲁士说：‘他是我的牧人，他要履行我的一切计划，要吩咐重建耶路撒冷，奠基重修圣殿。’”
